description: He wears a dark green knee-length wool tunic with narrow gold-beige knotwork trim along the neckline, chest opening, cuffs and hem, over a cream linen underlayer. A broad matching green fringed cloak with wide knotwork borders drapes across the shoulders and torso, held by a round ornate metal shoulder brooch. A dark brown leather belt with decorated round metal plaques circles the waist and has a hanging strap. Brown trousers are tucked into tall dark brown leather boots with crossed wrapping straps.
